properties.name: Two more prescribed layer pairs stop refusing; every detector skips what an accepted Decision withdrew; gaps that are one missing edge seen twice say so — and a fourth fix was reverted when existing pins showed it was already built
properties.rationale: Built on Anthony's 'go with your recommendation' for the buildable batch (two pairs + detector precision), and shaped by his mid-build question — 'we have done /root-cause on all the issues we're fixing? I don't want to fix a symptom or the wrong thing' — which was answered honestly and then proven right by the suite. WHERE EACH STANDS AGAINST ITS CAUSE: (1) the cause was an under-enumerated list and the fix is the list — complete, with the reporter's third pair deliberately held for a second count. (2) the cause was 'the graph holds the fact and the reader does not consult it', and the fix routes every reader through one consulting scan — the class, not the instance; the cost is one Decision scan per write generation, memoised. (3) is SYMPTOM-SIDE BY DESIGN and says so: the fact established that all three findings are correct and the complaint is aggregation, so grouping is the right treatment of the reporting; the PREVENTION of the forgotten edge is the open qs idea of a one-call 'wire this capability' (allocate+realizes+verifies), not built and awaiting a ruling. The revert is the lesson: a recorded fact is precedent to be checked (root-cause step ②), not a substitute for checking — the pins that caught it existed because someone had already done the work. WHAT IS NOT DONE: cross-referencing the heal-side cluster defect with the gaps; the third pair; the detector for 'a defect fact fixed but never INVALIDATED', now named as owed.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: THREE FIXES. (1) PRESCRIBED_LAYER_PAIRS (capture.rs) gains Decision-Verification and Requirement-Decision: a ruling written beside the check that measures its subject, and a requirement promoted from the brainstorm idea that spawned it, are REPORTED in search_first and no longer refused. The guard fires on the Decision/Requirement constructor (add_verification runs no near-match guard at all, which is why the pins create the Verification first). Decision-DesignEpoch (n=1) is watched, not added. Two pins in a_prescribed_layer_pair_no_longer_refuses.rs. (2) detect.rs gains discontinued_ids() — every id an ACCEPTED Decision has OBSOLETED, computed once per write generation into DerivedMemo — and scan_live_nodes(), which subtracts it; all 31 detector scans in detect.rs now read through it, and is_discontinued() consults the set first. A DesignRule retired the sanctioned way stops raising unstated_rule_enforcement, and so does every other type-keyed detector — the CLASS the fact named, not the instance. (3) group_shared_causes(): a post-pass over the assembled gaps that, when an unallocated_capability and an unrealized_capability share a capability, appends to each a sentence naming the sibling gap and the one `allocate` call that clears both. Nothing is dropped — the fact insisted all three findings are true — and a gap with no sibling is untouched. The unthreaded-cluster DEFECT (heal) is not cross-referenced yet; gaps only. ONE REVERT. A fourth change made unsatisfied_requirement skip `deferred` requirements, built from fact:defect-unsatisfied-requirement-fires-on-requirements-whose-status-is-the-answer, which the ledger showed as open. Two existing pins in the_surface_says_what_it_already_knew.rs failed: chg:the-surface-says-what-it-already-knew had ALREADY built the reporter's alternative — a deferred requirement is asked a different, lower-ranked 'still parked?' question — and never closed the fact. The skip silenced that designed question; reverted within the hour; the fact closed from its real fixer; the miss recorded as fact:a-defect-fixed-but-never-closed-on-the-record-was-re-fixed-wrongly-a-day-later. Pins observed failing first for all three fixes (E0425 for the grouping fn; a withdrawn rule still raising its gap; two pair refusals). core 1580/0, mcp 358/0, fmt/clippy clean.
